question: Who among the following was awarded the Padma Shri in 2021 for keeping the adivasi dance form ‘Gussadi’ alive?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kanaka Raju.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gussadi dancer** Kanaka Raju is from India.
 
• He received the** Padma Shri honour** from the** Indian government in 2021** for his contributions to the arts.
 
• In **1981,** he also participated in the **Republic Day procession.**
 
• As of right now, he serves as the Kanaka Raju Academy of **Gussadi dance's chief dance master**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ramsahay Pandey**:

 
 
• In the Indian State of **Madhya Pradesh, Sagar** is home to **Rai dancer **Ramsahay Pandey.
 
• Ram Sahay Panday received the** Padma Shri award **from the Indian government in** 2022** in recognition of his services to art.
 
 
 
• **Pandit Birju Maharaj:**
 
 
• **​Indian dancer, composer, vocalist**, and representative of the** Lucknow "Kalka-Bindadin" Gharana **of Kathak dance were Pandit Birju Maharaj.
 
• India's second-highest civilian accolade, the** Padma Vibhushan**, was given to Birju Maharaj in **1986.**
 
 
 
• **Srimanta Sankardev:**
 
 
• ​**Assamese saint-scholar, poet, writer, dancer, actor, singer, artist, and social-religious reformer, S**rimanta Sankardev lived in the **15th and 16th centuries. **
